name: Captain's Key
description: The only key to the treasure hold. It never leaves your person, except when it is in your desk.

name: Rusty Key
description: An old iron key, orange with rust and gnawed at one end. Someone has been missing this.

name: Cannon Fuse
description: A coil of slow match for touching off a gun. Brask keeps losing these, and then shouting about it.

name: Stores Ledger
description: Quill's list of everything aboard, down to the last biscuit. The last biscuit has been crossed out.
